quotes.partner_name: This GP Co-Investment Agreement is entered into as of January 15, 2026 between Example Fund GP LLC (the "General Partner") and Fictional Capital Partners LP (the "Partner"). (p.1)
quotes.scope: This Agreement governs the general partner commitment to Model Fund I (the "Fund") and every investment the Fund makes. (§1.2)
quotes.capital_pct: The Partner shall fund forty percent (40%) of the GP Commitment, and the General Partner shall fund the balance. (§2.1)
quotes.promote_pct_of_gp_side: The Partner shall be entitled to fifty percent (50%) of the Promote distributed to the General Partner. (§3.1)
quotes.fees: The Partner shall not be entitled to any fee. All asset management, acquisition, disposition and other fees are payable to the Sponsor. (§4.1)
quotes.effective_date: This Agreement is effective as of January 15, 2026. (§5.1)
